test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I shared a clipping of myself dead-lifting and doing back squats.

options.text: Dead-lifting and back squats are being done by myself.
A clipping of myself doing dead-lifting and back squats was shared by me.
A clipping of myself doing dead-lifting and back squats is shared by me
A clipping of myself doing dead-lifting and back squats are being shared by me.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "I shared a clipping of myself dead-lifting and doing back squats."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a clipping of myself dead-lifting and doing back squats" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "shared" to "was shared" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "me."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A clipping of myself doing dead-lifting and back squats was shared by me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Dead-lifting and back squats are being done by myself." – Incorrect structure and verb tense.
 
• **Option 3:** "A clipping of myself doing dead-lifting and back squats is shared by me." – Incorrect verb tense; "is shared" instead of "was shared."
 
• **Option 4:** "A clipping of myself doing dead-lifting and back squats are being shared by me." – Subject-verb agreement error; "A clipping" is singular but "are" is used.
